lead_fa: Devourer یک اسپک کست‌کنندهٔ ۲۵ یاردی است که با قدرت Void بازی می‌کند؛ با [[Consume]] و [[Reap]] Fury و Soul Fragment می‌سازی و با ورود به [[Void Metamorphosis]] به برست اصلی می‌رسی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Annihilator]] که برای همهٔ محتواها به‌جز Delves انتخاب اول است و [[Void-Scarred]] که سبک میله‌ای-هیبرید دارد و در Delves برتر است.

strengths: Incredible mobility (base DH kit plus Shift)
Frequent and high-damage Void Metamorphosis windows
Strong self-sustain healing and a strong defensive in Blur
Chaos Brand debuff: increases enemy magic damage taken, unique to Demon Hunters
weaknesses: Mistakes during the Void Metamorphosis window are punishing
Voidblade and other melee talents can put you in danger
Melee talents are required for the Void-Scarred hero tree
Long cast times on Collapsing Star and The Hunt

patch_changes: Collapsing Star no longer incurs a 5s cooldown if its cast is cancelled; it doubles its range during the cast; it slows Fury drain for only 1.5x its total cast time until cast again
Voidpurge now reduces Void Ray's cooldown by 2.5s (was 2s)
Soulforged Blades now increases the Critical Strike chance of Voidblade and Hungering Slash by 18% (was 15%)
Void-Scarred: Demonic Intensity causes Collapsing Star to reset The Hunt's cooldown
Void-Scarred: Violent Transformation no longer increases damage of or resets The Hunt; now resets Soul Immolation
Void-Scarred: Monster Rising now grants 10% Intellect (was 15%) and +20% Collapsing Star damage (was 15%)
Overall: Void-Scarred now plays more like Annihilator, extending Void Meta and casting multiple Collapsing Stars

hero.recommendation: Annihilator is the recommended option for ALL content aside from Delves.
hero.annihilator: Focuses on calling down void meteors through Voidfall; more resources via World Killer and Celestial Echoes; passive Haste from Swift Erasure speeds up the rotation. Defense: Phase Shift, a fluctuating 2-8% damage reduction, plus more Soul Fragment generation.
hero.void_scarred: Melee hybrid: uses Voidblade, Hungering Slash, The Hunt to trigger powerful Voidsurge and amplify Void Metamorphosis; empowers you outside Void Meta with Enduring Torment and Monster Rising. Defense: Set Fire to the Pain (minor 0.5% DR) or Improved Soul Rending (leech). Utility: Pursuit of Angriness, Wave of Debilitation stun.
hero.note: Both hero trees are weak defensively; the difference there is minimal.

concepts: Avoid resource waste: Devourer ramps into Void Metamorphosis windows; access is entirely based on Soul Fragment and Fury generation, so minimize waste of both.
Plan Cooldown Windows: damage revolves around Void Metamorphosis with power spikes entering and exiting; use it as many times as possible with minimal disruptions.
Be aware of your surroundings: 25-yard ranged spec with stationary casts on its strongest spells; use Shift proactively to position safely.

rotation.vm_mechanics: Void Metamorphosis has no cooldown or duration: it becomes available at 50 Soul Fragments (35 with Soul Glutton); Entropy starts you at 25 Soul Fragments. Its duration is your Fury bar, instantly refilled on entry and draining faster over time; at 0 Fury you drop out. Inside: Mastery increases; Consume upgrades into Devour (more damage, shorter cast, -1s Reap cooldown per cast); Reap upgrades into Cull; Void Ray deals more damage, costs no Fury, pauses Fury drain while channeling and gains a 14s hasted cooldown that does not persist outside; you gain Collapsing Star.

rotation.opener_note: Devourer has no traditional opener: Void Metamorphosis is not ready at pull. The opener is a ramp to reach it as fast as possible; Annihilator's opener is fluid due to Voidfall procs (at 3 stacks of Voidfall, use Reap).
rotation.melee_trick: The 'Huggle' trick (Voidblade into Vengeful Retreat, cast The Hunt midair, then Void Metamorphosis) needs roughly 14% haste; worth doing in single target every time it is available, not very useful in AoE after 12.1.5.

gear.gearing_rules: Grab as much Haste and Mastery as possible, but the abundance of Haste from cantrip effects lowers its value; BiS pieces tend to have Crit. Use two passive-stat trinkets. Collect all 4 cantrip items for stat procs at increased item level. Sim with Raidbots.
